chunks: God chooses messengers from the angels and from the human beings. Verily God is all-hearing and all-seeing.
ai.seo_question: Who does God choose as messengers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis to support the concept of divine selection (Istifa) for both angels and humans, underscores the theological basis for the Prophethood of Muhammad (PBUH) and the Imams. The concluding attributes of All-Hearing and All-Seeing serve as a guarantee of God's oversight over the messengers' duties and their reception of revelation, reinforcing the authenticity of their message.
